conbody.p: When Intelligent Speed Limit Assist is not working properly, the warning message will appear on the cluster for several seconds, and the Master warning light () and the Intelligent Speed Limit Assist indicator light () will appear on the cluster.
Warning message: Check driver assistance system.

If Intelligent Speed Limit Assist does not operate properly after it is removed, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
